messages:
Marta: Quick thread to capture fallout from the failover smoke tests. We saw interleaved tokens when hosted -> private handoff happened mid-stream. Client saw duplicated intro lines.
Evan: I reproduced. The adapter forwarded the first chunk before the private runtime confirmed session lease and applied the session token. Race.
Diego: Current flow: allocate lease -> send session token (async) -> stream. If token apply is slower than first-chunk-sent we lose prefix.
Sofia: Two UX-safe options: (1) synchronous lease apply before any token emission (adds a one-off tail during failover), or (2) optimistic stream + immutable prefix marker that client can discard if mismatch.
Marta: I'm leaning to (1) for chat routes. Clients expect conversational continuity. For batch/generation routes we can use (2). Need per-route policy.
Evan: Agree. Also propose a lightweight session-lease contract: {lease_id, apply_deadline_ms, nonce, lease_type: transient|sticky}. Adapter must wait for apply_ack if route.requires_strong_affinity==true.
Diego: Implementation caveat: waiting blocks adapter connection slot. For high QPS we should bound wait to 200ms and then fall back to degrade header instead of blocking forever.
Sofia: Add degrade header: X-Redwood-Failover-Note: restored|cold|partial. That lets SDKs show a subtle "context may have been lost" UX.
Marta: Security: lease token must be short-lived, envelope-wrapped, and include a scope claim tying it to a tenant and route id. No plaintext session blobs.
Evan: Also we need a metric: failover_block_ms, failover_block_oom_risk, failover_stream_duplications. Tag by route and target_mode (private/dedicated).
Diego: Ops request: on-rollout, ability to enable "fast-failover" mode where we prefer availability over consistency for a short window. Useful during incidents. Make it feature-flagged per-cluster.
Sofia: We should surface per-route defaults in Console: conservative for chat, permissive for embed/generation. DevEx needs copy.
InfraBot: Deploy note: failover-lease-checker v1 canary -> 2 hosts. Monitoring dashboards updated.
Marta: Action items: Evan to spec lease proto and apply semantics (INF-1001), Diego to add adapter timeout and degrade header (INF-1002), Sofia to add Console toggle and DevEx doc (DOCS-450).
Evan: I'll include sequence diagram and an optimization for piggybacking lease apply on existing health handshake.
Diego: I'll add unit tests that inject artificial apply delays and assert no duplicate prefix tokens in strong-affinity mode.
Sofia: I'll draft short customer guidance about tradeoffs and a fallback flag we can toggle during incidents.
Marta: Thanks. If nobody objects I'll schedule a 30m sync to align owners tomorrow.
Evan: Works for me. :thumbsup:
Diego: +1
Sofia: +1
